unit.why: A short memorate, heard from the master, about a man taken up to the heavenly palaces on the night of his bar mitzvah to choose his soul, with the narrator's guess that the master meant himself.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי ממנו ז"ל שאמר שהוא הכיר
stories.summary_en: The master told of a man who, on his bar mitzvah night, was led up to the upper palaces and allowed to choose any soul; he chose a very great one, yet remained a lowly man, and the narrator supposes the master spoke of himself out of humility.

quotes: היו מוליכים אותו למעלה בהיכלות עליונים
tags.why: The man's soul is taken up to the upper palaces while he is alive.

quotes: למעלה בהיכלות עליונים ונתנו לו רשות
tags.why: The choice of a soul takes place in the heavenly palaces.
The master hides his own experience out of humility.
The point of the anecdote is the master's humility.

quotes: וההשערה היה שהוא בעצמו היה זה
tags.why: The listeners realize that the anonymous man was the speaker himself.

quotes: שמעתי ממנו ז"ל שאמר שהוא הכיר
tags.why: The tale is framed as told by the master.
